book.name: Mateo
book.title: To Madojow no Nawnangonon no Sinuyat ni Mateo

content: To mgo Tumanon to mgo Pariseo
Na, meyduon naman-andiya ki Jesus no mgo Pariseo dow mgo maistru to tinuuhan no napuun diya to Jerusalem. Mig-usip sikandan,
“Nokoy no ogyapas man to mgo inanad nu to tumanon no nabuyatan ta? Su ogkoon sikandan no kona ogpanghugas to boyad dan to paagi no ing-anad to mgo minuna ta.”
Mig-iling si Jesus, “Na, sikiyu naan, nokoy no ogyapas kow man to sugu to Diyus agun iyan matuman now to iyu no mgo tumanon?
Su to sugu to Diyus pig-iling, ‘Tahuda to amoy dow inoy nu.’
Insugu din isab no inggad hintawa no ogpasipaya to ginikanan oghimatajan.

Di sikiyu, yahi to ing-anad now. Su inggad meyduon podom igkatabang to otow to ginikanan din, di ogpabalibadon now nasi sikandin to pag-iling, ‘Meyduon podom bobogoy ku iyu, di impaabin kud nasi to Diyus.’
Duon to sikan, klaru yagboy no pinakawada now sikan sugu to Diyus to pagtahud to ginikanan agun iyan matuman sikan iyu no tumanon.
Kunungkun mangkatarong! Tinood yagboy to diya kagi to Diyus no sinuyat ni Isaias bahin iyu no pig-iling din,

content.text: ‘Seini no mgo otow og-iling to pigtahud a dan,
di kotob da to tumuy to dila dan,
su wada a ibotang duon to ginhawa dan.
Wada pues to pagsimba dan kanay,
su iyan da igpang-anad dan to tumanon no pig-otawan.’

content: Pighimun ni Jesus to kaotawan aw ikagihi, “Paminogi now seini og-ikagihon ku aw panginsabuti now.
Kona no iyan ogpakaligsom to otow to igsungit duon to ba-ba din, di sikan madoot no ogyogwa duon to ba-ba din iyan ogpakaligsom.”
Dajun padani ki Jesus to mgo inanad din aw usip, “Wada ka kamaan no nadootan to mgo Pariseo to sikan pig-ikagi nu?”
Migtabak si Jesus, “Angod sikandan to bagnot no wada itanom to Amoy ku no diya to yangit no puli ogpandutduton.
Pabay-ani sikan mgo Pariseo. Angod isab sikandan to mgo buta no ogpikit to angod dan no buta. Ogkauyug sikandan tibo duon to yugi.
Kagi ni Pedro, “Hiluwasi koy kun to diya pananglitan nu.”
Mig-iling si Jesus, “Sikiyu isab, wada kow pad naan makasabut?
To ogkoonon to otow diya ogdeg to gotok, aw tapus to sikan, oggawas da to yawa.
Di to ogyogwa duon to ba-ba din duon ogkapuun to ginhawa din. Sikan to ogpakaligsom kandin.
Su to ginhawa to otow iyan ogkapuunan to madoot no mgo hona-hona, paghimatoy, paghinang to kayaw-ajan, pagpangawat, pagkistigus to gayu dow pagbuung to dongog to duma.
Sikan to ogpakaligsom to otow. Kona no iyan igkaligsomi to otow ko kona ogpanghugas to boyad ko ogkoon.”
To Pagtuu to Bohi no Kona no Hibru
Dajun panow si Jesus aw andiya to banwa no sakup to mgo siyudad to Tiro dow Sidon.

Na, meyduon bohi no taga-duon no kona no Hibru su sakup sikandin to tribu to Canaan. Mig-anduon sikandin ki Jesus aw ikagi to maagbot, “Sir, Kaliwat ni Hari David, sadangay kae-ati a su to anak ku no bohi kanunoy ogsamukon to madoot no ispiritu no hilabi ogpaantus kandin.”
Di wada iikagi si Jesus. Dajun padani to mgo inanad din aw ikagi, “Masamuk sikan bohi no ogduma-duma ita. Payagujon ta buwa.”
Dajun ikagi si Jesus, “Iyan da impaandini kanay to mgo kaliwat ni Israel, su angod sikandan to nayagak no mgo karneru.”
Di sikan bohi nasi on migyuhud duon to atubangan ni Jesus aw pakimayuuy no mig-iling, “Sir, tabangi a man.”
Mig-iling si Jesus, “Kona no madojow ko agawon to koonon to mgo bata agun igtimbag diya to mgo idu.”
“Iyan man iyan Sir,” kagi to sikan bohi, “di ngani man to idu, di ogpakapanginamut to mgo timu no ogkatanak ko ogkoon to mgo agayon dan.”
Dajun ikagi si Jesus, “Pagkahogot to pagtuu nu, Iya! Na, ogtumanon ku sikan hangyu nu.” Duon-dajun migdojow to anak to sikan bohi.
To Pagpakoon ni Jesus to 4000 no mgo Otow
Dajun panow si Jesus aw pauli diya to higad to danow to Galilea. Miggamat sikandin to bubungan aw ingkud duon.

Mahan-in hilabi to mgo otow no naman-anduon kandin no namandaya to mgo pulid, mgo buta, mgo pogkot, mgo poha, dow duma pad no mgo otow no mey sakit. Imbotang dan duon to atubangan ni Jesus aw pigpandojow din.

Pagkita to mgo otow to sikan, naboyong yagboy sikandan aw sajaa dan to Diyus to mgo kaliwat ni Israel. Su to mgo poha nakaikagi on aw to mgo pogkot migdojow on. To mgo pulid nakapanow on aw to mgo buta migkita on.

Dajun himuna ni Jesus to mgo inanad din aw ikagihi, “Ogkae-at a to seini mgo otow su tatoyu on no aedow dan kani aw wadad on ogkakoon dan. Kona ku sikandan ogpapanawon no ogbontason su unu ko hanipon duon to pangindaenan.”
Dajun usip to mgo inanad, “Na, andei ki kay ogpudut to pagkoon no igu igkapakoon to seini mahan-in no mgo otow kani to hilit?”
Dajun usip si Jesus, “Pila no buuk to pan duon iyu?” Kagi dan, “Pitu, dow pila ubag no buuk no isda.”
Dajun pamaingkuda ni Jesus sikan mgo otow duon to pasak.

Pigdawat din sikan pitu no buuk no pan dow sikan mgo isda aw pasalamat to Diyus. Dajun din panibaga sikan aw ibogoy diya to mgo inanad din agun ipamogoy diya to kaotawan. Mighan-in yagboy sikan pan dow isda,
kaling nakakoon sikandan tibo kotob no nangkahantoy. Tapus to pagkoon, pigpanghimun to mgo inanad to nasama, aw kaponu to pitu no ka baeknan!
Upat no libu to mgo yukos no nakakoon wada yabot to kabujagan dow kabataan.
Tapus to sikan, pigpalikat ni Jesus sikan mgo otow. Dajun sikandin sakoy dow to mgo inanad din to bangka aw andiya to Magadan.
